Author: Saagi
Name: Achieve Ex+
Description: Experimental Achieve Ex+ testing build. Use /achex to track achievements and test native Achievement update flows.
Punchline: Experimental Ex native Achievement testing build for /achex.
TestingChangelog: Experimental Ex prerelease. Uses native Achievement UI opens plus passive progress-slot reads; no plugin-originated direct progress-request call or remote-service call. Includes flash/UI motion warning, quarter-size window parking with restore-before-close, reset-scale recovery, mutually exclusive timed auto/event-trigger update modes, and an all-event-types trigger toggle.
